matched_inputs: same immutable task population per workload and repetition in both arms; prove fresh reset or cache-busting

primary.repetition_summary: median across all valid requests in that repetition
primary.arm_summary: median of three matched repetition medians
primary.pass: at concurrency 1 for both input lengths, candidate median <= 0.90 * baseline median; all three paired candidate medians strictly lower; candidate repetition maximum strictly below baseline repetition minimum
primary.limits: visible chunks can contain multiple tokens; this is a stream-window proxy, not exact token interarrival latency

secondary.per_request: first visible output latency and total request duration
secondary.repetition_summary: median across valid requests within each repetition
secondary.throughput: verified output tokens across valid measured requests / measured burst makespan, summarized by median across three repetitions
secondary.pass: at each workload candidate median first-token and end-to-end latency <= 1.05 * baseline and candidate median aggregate throughput >= 0.95 * baseline; no new errors
secondary.ambiguous_or_insufficient: inconclusive, never a favorable assumed pass
secondary.noise_rule: At each workload, if the three paired repetition ratios straddle the 5% guardrail the result is inconclusive; all three beyond the guardrail is a rejection.

quality: separate frozen qualification-contract.json; qualification and warmup excluded from measurements
